input.summary: Extend licence to Client affiliates and contractors and permit transfer to a successor.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the licence to cover our affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf, since our origination operations are run partly through affiliated entities and outsourced processors, and added a successor-transfer carve-out to the assignment clause. If preferred, we can accept affiliate coverage on written notice to TrueLink instead.

ops.oldText: TrueLink hereby grants to Client a non-exclusive license to use the Interface
ops.newText: TrueLink hereby grants to Client, its affiliates and its contractors acting on Client's behalf, a non-exclusive license to use the Interface

ops.oldText: except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
ops.newText: except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate or to a successor in interest in connection with a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of the assigning party's assets.
